The forum has vibrated too long without a PBF game. I did not manage to quite finish the challenge accepted against infinitor but if you guys can forgive me that I'll try my hand at running a game again. I'm gonna leave it to the players to decide wether we play on advanced, challenge or even advanced challenge. So as always first come first served and please vote at the same time the advanced and challenge options. Setup was randomised and I'm all open to seeing the Adamant Sentinels and Best of Time Chrono ranger in action if players want tpo try them out.

Aminia wanted the Freedom Five out of the picture but her own interdimentional powers reminded her that time travelers were a threat to even her best laid out plan, She thus devised a plan to take them out all at the same time. She thus started pulling strings to make believe that Cosmic Omnitron was building up a drone army on mars. Considering the time needed to get there it eliminated the chance of reinforcements coming to their aid...

Wagner Mars Base

posts.name: Medic-Tank
posts.cooked:
A long dangerous and useless trip- ROUND 1 - Sloppy work from Threat to Explosion

Villain Turn (Miss Information - Demure Office Worker)
Start -
  No clue in play Miss Information doesn't flip

 No Hero cards to destroy for "Threat" to the President

Play - What doesn't kill you (Ongoing, Clue)
 - Sloppy Work, Miss Information plays Diversionary Tactics reveals Misplaced Memo x 2, "Explosion" in the Lab , Isolated Hero and Missing Ressources. "Explosion" in the Lab is put in play then the revealed cards are discarded. Trash is shuffled back in the deck.

- Diversionary Tactics plays the top card of the villain deck
 - Missing Ressources (One-Shot) Reveal the top card of 1 hero deck. Each player discards every card which shares any of the revealed cards keyword. Discard the revealed card

End - Miss information attempts to destroy 2 hero ongoings of equipment there are none in play

- "Threat" to the President would destroy a hero non-character card from the hero with the most cards in play (The Sentinels) none are available

- The Sentinels have 3 or more cards in play but none eligible for destruction

=======
Effects:
- At the start of the villain turn, if there are 4 clue cards in play flip Miss Information's Villain Character Card (Miss Information - Demure Office Worker)
- At the end of the villain turn,destroy hero ongoing or equipment cards where X = the number of Diversion cards in play. (Miss Information - Demure Office Worker)

- Increase damage dealt to hero targets by 1(Miss Information - Demure Office Worker Advanced)

- Whenever a Clue card enters play, play the top card of the villain deck. (Miss Information - Challenge Mode)

- At the end of the villain turn, the player with the most cards in play must destroy one of their non-character cards ("Threat" to the President)

- At the start of the villain turn, the players may destroy 5 non-character hero cards. If they do, destroy this card ("Threat" to the President)

- Increase damage dealt by villain targets (What doesn't kill you...)

- At the start of the villain turn, if there are no Diversion cards in play. Play the top card of the villain deck. (What doesn't kill you...)

- At the end of the villain turn, each player with 3 or more cards in play must destroy one of their cards ("Explosion" in the lab)

- At the start of the villain turn, 1 hero may discard their hand to destroy this card. ("Explosion" in the lab)


 

Status
======
Miss Information

Villain Cards in Play: "Threat" to the President (Diversion), What doesn't kill you (Clue), "Explosion" in the lab (Diversion)

# of clues in play:1
Villain Trash: Diversionary Tactics, Missing Ressources

-------

Visionnary          [26]

No damage has been dealt this turn, but loads of destruction have hit the board. Missing ressources still needs to be resolved as a card needs to be revealed from a hero deck to know what keyword is targeted. Threat to the president was the setup Diversion.
